category: Application Library examples: Electric Discharge Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Electric Discharge Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: AC Breakdown Voltage of Parallel Electrodes in Air [Electric Discharge Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Electric Discharge Module (Electrical Breakdown): AC Breakdown Voltage of Parallel Electrodes in Air.
